title: i asked claude to make a gta style game set on a specific street in denver.... not bad
author: AuthorMaterial7495
selftext: Just thought it would be an interesting experiment to see if it could actually copy over a real life place correctly.

comments.author: _DCtheTall_
comments.body: Was this a one-shot prompt or did you have to do a lot of planning and refinement?

replies.author: AuthorMaterial7495
replies.body: A few planning prompts before launching anything.  My setup also has a lot of stuff it can use (ie sourcing its own assets, signing up for apis, image/audio gen stuff).   I had it to a browser game first and then basically said "Redo this with a real game engine and make it look better" .

replies.author: _DCtheTall_
replies.body:
Cool, thanks for the tips. I am a software engineer getting into AI game dev for fun. I wanted to make a GTA-like game for a town my cousins and I vacationed in as a family and this is very helpful to know when I do that.

Did you make it use Google Maps to get the streets and geography? Or some other method?
